meta.name: cavecrew
meta.description: When to delegate to `cavecrew-investigator` (locate code), `cavecrew-builder` (1-2 file edit) or `cavecrew-reviewer` (diff review) instead of working inline or using `Explore`. Their output is compressed, so main context lasts longer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按需分派子代理处理代码定位、修改与审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常用 AI 写代码,想通过子代理分工节省上下文。
copy.tagline_en: Delegate to sub-agents for code search, edits, and reviews to save context.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code with AI and want to manage context by delegating tasks to sub-agents.

howto.what: 装上 cavecrew 后，Claude 会把三类活儿交给专门的子代理，结果都用短格式返回：找代码位置给出「文件:行号」清单；改 1~2 个文件并在改后回读核对；审代码改动按行号列问题。这让主对话的上下文占用更少。
howto.when: 当任务是定位代码、对已知位置的 1~2 个文件做精确修改、或审查代码改动找问题，且不需要长篇解释、简短输出就够用时。

say.text: 帮我找一下 validateInput 在哪定义、谁在调用它。
say.note: Claude 派定位子代理，返回「文件:行号」清单和总数。

say.text: 把 src/utils.ts 第 42 行的超时时间改成 3000 毫秒。
say.note: Claude 交给单文件改动子代理，改后回读核对。

say.text: 审查我这个分支代码改动，列出要修的地方。
say.note: Claude 派审查子代理，按行号列出问题、严重度和修法。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude routes three kinds of jobs to terse subagents: finding code (file:line lists), editing 1–2 files (with re-read verification), and reviewing code changes (line-sorted issue lists), so each task consumes less main context.
howto.when_en: Use when the task is to locate code, make a precise edit to 1–2 already-known files, or review a code change for problems, and a short answer is enough.

say_en.text: Find where validateInput is defined and who calls it.
say_en.note: Returns a file:line list with totals.

say_en.text: Change the timeout at src/utils.ts:42 to 3000 ms.
say_en.note: Single-file edit agent re-reads to verify.

say_en.text: Review my branch code changes and list what needs fixing.
say_en.note: Reviewer returns line-level issues and suggested fixes.
